newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: QUILMES TO BUY 85 PCT IN BREWER BIECKERT.
newsitem.headline: QUILMES TO BUY 85 PCT IN BREWER BIECKERT.

text.p: Quilmes Industrial SA said on Monday it exercised an option to buy 85 percent of Bieckert.
The option values Bieckert at $40 million, including debt.
Bieckert had a 6.5 percent share of Argentina's beer market in 1995.
The purchase is still subject to certain conditions and to the completion of the due diligence process, Quilmes, a Luxembourg brewing holding company, added.

The Buenos Aires Stock Exchange said on Monday it suspended trade in local brewer Cerveceria Bieckert due to talks to sell a 85 percent stake in Bieckert to Quilmes Industrial SA. The suspension continued until more information was provided.
